resources.string: The photo is blurred
Hold the tablet steady and try again.
The photo is out of focus
Tap the subject on the screen to focus, then try again.
The photo is too dark
Move into the light or turn on the torch.
The photo is too bright
Move out of direct sunlight or change your angle.
Reflection on part of the subject
Change your angle if you can.
The subject is cut off
Move back and fit it in the frame.
The subject is too small
Move closer so it fills the frame.
The subject is too close
Move back a little so all of it fits.
The photo is too small
Take the photo again. If this keeps happening, tell your supervisor.
The photo could not be read
Take the photo again.
The photo has no valid orientation
Take the photo again.
Something is blocking the view
Check that nothing covers the lens or the subject, then try again.
Location permission is missing
Allow precise location to take evidence photos.
Location is turned off
Turn on location to continue.
No location yet
Wait for the location, ideally with a clear view of the sky.
The location is out of date
Wait a moment for a fresh location, then try again.
The location is not accurate enough
Move to a place with a clear view of the sky and try again.
The location was not saved in the photo
Take the photo again.
The location may not be real
This photo will be flagged for review.
The photo could not be checked on this device
Take the photo again. If this keeps happening, tell your supervisor.
Camera is not available on this device
Camera is being used by another app
Could not take the photo
Storage is full
The photo could not be read
Location permission is needed to take evidence photos
Turn on location to continue
Waiting for location…
Live guidance is not available
